Hypnotized! Reincarnated as a monster from hell!

It Actually Puts YOU In The Picture - Can You Stand It?

A Ritz is afraid of nothing ... but ... THIS ... IS ... SOMETHING!
38579: An urban family inherits an old country house located in a small village. 38835: General Othello's marriage is destroyed when vengeful Ensign Iago convinces him that his new wife has been unfaithful.
The greatest Othello ever by the greatest actor of our time

A great idea ...if only the inspector hadn't taken Stan on his trial run to the Windsor Safari Park
Your Favourite BUSES Fun Gang... Back Again in Their SECOND Big Screen Comedy!

Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in partnership with The Film Foundation in 1998.
40371: A gritty story taking place in Stockholm, about the passionate love between the self-abusive Sebastian who wants to be a woman, and the easy-going Andreas who is certainly not gay.
I've Never Loved a Boy Like You Before...
40627: A grieving policeman and a rickshaw driver are brought together by a dark, tragic secret that will change their lives forever.
40883: Two cousins haven't spoken for almost twenty years, thanks to the enmity that their fathers feel toward one another. But an accident suddenly brings the cousins back together and thrusts them deep into the heart of the mafia.
41139: Set in the 1980s, a young Italian-American from the wrong side of the tracks falls for a Jewish girl from Long Island.

If you think you know her, think again.

YOU WILL SEE HER TRANSFORMED BY THE WONDEROUS NEW TECHNICOLOR
42675: A woman grapples with the consequences of her husband's imprisonment.

43187: A new form of observational documentary that borders on science-fiction, John & Jane follows the stories of six Call Agents that answer American 1-800 numbers at a Mumbai call center.
43443: A bohemian encounters a woman with whom a love affair ensues.

43955: Rafael Sabatini's story of the swashbuckling era and of Bardeleys, the handsome courtier who could win any woman he set his mind to...and was not above boasting about it to all who would listen.
The screen's great lover in a dashing role!

A Horse Worth Killing For. A Dream Worth Dying For.
44467: The usual gang of robbers are hired by a thief from Milan to steal a suitcase full of money, but troubles will hinder the success of the operation.

44979: Hungary, 1990s. Travel abroad is finally possible, but unaffordable. By forging international train tickets, three young people get to know the world.
What good is freedom if you can't live it?

45491: A young boy after the Hungarian uprising of 1956, raised by his mother with the tale of an idealized dead father, has his world turned upside down when a brutish man appears, claiming to be his true parent.

46003: Burned out and lonely Rocky is almost 50 years old and has seen better times as a womanizer. One day, Thorben shows up at his door claiming to be his son. He is trying to get advice on how to be successful with women.

HE MADE HIS ENEMIES BEG FOR MERCY!

Her mind was the most erotic and dangerous part of her body.

He lived only for the flesh and the sword!

She's a natural born fighter… back to school!

What was the truth about Ada?

50867: A car crash sparks a war between local police and an international terrorist organization.

Introducing the most extraordinary gorilla in the world.
